evidence: Doc lines 9-12 only says `runtime/events/store` provider, `RunEventsConfig`, `RunJournal`, and events API; it omits configured backends and fallback semantics.

Source `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/events/store/__init__.py` lines 5-23: `make_run_event_store` is implemented in `__init__.py`, supports `memory`, `db`, and `jsonl`; `db` falls back to `MemoryRunEventStore` when `get_session_factory()` is `None`.
Source `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/events/store/db.py` lines 1-4 and 25-28: `DbRunEventStore` persists to `run_events` and truncates trace content by `max_trace_content`.
docFindings.issue: The doc is source-under-specified and slightly misleading as a provider chapter: it does not identify the actual factory file, the three event-store backends, or the DB-to-memory fallback. This matters because learners could assume RunEventRow is always used whenever RunJournal writes events.
docFindings.patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .agent_context/final_review/docs_md/264｜Runtime Events Store Provider 详解.md
@@
 | 模块点 | 说明 |
 |-|-|
-| runtime/events/store | run event store provider。 |
-| RunEventsConfig | 配置事件存储。 |
-| RunJournal | 写入 message/tool/token 事件。 |
-| thread_runs events API | 读取事件。 |
+| runtime/events/store/__init__.py | `make_run_event_store(config)` 是事件存储工厂。 |
+| RunEventsConfig | 通过 `run_events.backend` 选择 `memory`、`db` 或 `jsonl`。 |
+| memory backend | `MemoryRunEventStore` 用于开发/测试，不落 `run_events` 表。 |
+| db backend | `DbRunEventStore` 复用 SQLAlchemy session factory，写入 `RunEventRow`，并按 `max_trace_content` 截断 trace。 |
+| jsonl backend | `JsonlRunEventStore` 写 JSONL 文件，适合轻量单机持久化。 |
+| fallback | `run_events.backend=db` 但 session factory 不存在时，会回退到 `MemoryRunEventStore`。 |
+| RunJournal | 写入 human/message/trace/token 等事件，再由 store 分配 thread 内递增 seq。 |
+| thread_runs events API | 通过 RunEventStore 读取 messages/events。 |
@@
 flowchart TD
-  RunEventsConfig --> MakeEventStore
-  MakeEventStore --> RunEventStore
-  RunJournal --> RunEventStore
-  RunAgent --> RunJournal
-  ThreadRunsRouter --> RunEventStore
-  RunEventStore --> EventsResponse
-  EventsResponse --> FrontendDebug
+  RunEventsConfig --> MakeEventStore[make_run_event_store]
+  MakeEventStore --> Memory[MemoryRunEventStore]
+  MakeEventStore --> Db[DbRunEventStore]
+  MakeEventStore --> Jsonl[JsonlRunEventStore]
+  Db --> RunEventRow[run_events table]
+  Db --> Fallback[no session factory -> memory]
+  RunAgent --> RunJournal
+  RunJournal --> Store[chosen RunEventStore]
+  ThreadRunsRouter --> Store
+  Store --> EventsResponse
 ```
*** End Patch
 ```
